name: WoutWoot
description:
WoutWoot is pseudo-anarchy survival with a real player-driven economy.

⚔ No claims. Anything can be raided. Hide your base well, build it strong and trust carefully.

⇄ Player economy. Sell to the server, trade on the auction house, fill buy orders and put bounties on rivals.

✦ 20 custom enchants, from Drill and Lifesteal to Doppelganger.

▣ Stacked spawners. Stack up to 5,000 in one block and sell everything they drop.

◆ Sigils, not gambling. Earn Sigils by voting and playing, then pick exactly the reward you want. Sigil Rain every two hours.

🗡 Custom 3D weapon and armour skins, tradeable between players.

🎙 Proximity voice chat.

☁ A sky citadel hub with parkour, a PvP colosseum and minigames.

∞ No resets, ever. The world border grows with the community.

Java (latest): woutwoot.com · Bedrock: bedrock.woutwoot.com (port 19132)

Bedrock players: vote with a dot before your name, e.g. .Steve

Vote daily for Vote Sigils!
